Name: Trick or Treat Mod
Author: tikachu92
Description:
On the day of the egg festival, villagers will give out chocolate bunnies, chocolate eggs, marshmallow animals, and jelly beans.
On the day of halloween, villagers will give out peanut butter/chocolate, candy corn, and chocolate raisins.
(For both days, villagers also give out "common" candy, e.g. chocolate bars, chocolate milk, lollipops, and caramel chocolate bars.)

Depends on JsonAssets (which in turn depends on ExpandedPreconditionsUtility and SpaceCore)
